0022600004.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Timberwolves visit the Miami Heat, and Minnesota will be without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery. Last season, DiVincenzo averaged 12.2 points and 30.4 minutes per game. The Timberwolves won both meetings in 2025-26, including a 122-94 victory in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026.
